# Deutsche Welle (DW)

> DW is Germany's international news organization covering geopolitical conflicts, German politics, humanitarian crises, technology, finance, and cultural stories with global perspective.

DW provides comprehensive coverage of major international events including the Iran-Israel conflict, German elections, banking sector developments, and AI governance. The site emphasizes human-interest stories alongside hard news analysis.

## Key Topics

- Iran-Israel conflict
- Iran humanitarian crisis
- German politics
- Baden-Württemberg election
- Greens (Grüne)
- Cem Özdemir
- USA military strategy
- Unicredit-Commerzbank merger
- Industrial AI
- NATO security
- Bundesliga
- Healthcare shortages
- Women's rights
- Meta content moderation
- Trump administration
